rule: Written before any candidate was scored. Each candidate is fitted on rows before 2024 at four of five company folds and scores 2024 and 2025 at the fifth. Its mark is the batch share at 90% reach, read from the pooled scores of each year, averaged over the two years. Start from the table logistic. The next candidate replaces the current one only if its mark is at least 1 point higher and it is not lower in either year. So the trees must earn their extra complexity, and the text input stays only if it helps at equal reach.
